photos.name: aliquot-jar-starting-level
photos.summary: Aliquot jar filled with a dough sample at its starting level, sitting on the stovetop next to a red-lidded container. Used to track bulk ferment rise percentage.

photos.name: first-loaf-leaf-score-closeup
photos.summary: Close-up of the first loaf cooling on a wire rack, showing a decorative leaf score pattern with well-opened cuts and a flour-dusted crust with deep golden color.

photos.name: first-loaf-leaf-score-on-rack
photos.summary: First loaf on a copper wire cooling rack, displaying the full leaf score pattern with good oven spring and an ear visible along the top edge.

photos.name: first-loaf-leaf-score-vsco
photos.summary: Stylized close-up of the first loaf's leaf score with warm, saturated tones. The opened cuts show a branching stem-and-leaf pattern against the flour-dusted crust.

photos.name: first-loaf-wide-angle-on-rack
photos.summary: Wide-angle view of the first loaf centered on a round copper cooling rack, showing the full leaf score pattern from above with kitchen counter and gooseneck kettle in the background.

photos.name: second-loaf-internal-temp-209f
photos.summary: Second loaf on a cooling rack with a digital thermometer inserted reading 209 degrees F. A single slash score with moderate spring is visible on the golden-brown crust.

photos.name: two-loaves-in-proofing-baskets
photos.summary: Two shaped dough rounds resting seam-side up in cloth-lined oval proofing baskets on the counter, ready for cold proofing overnight.
